import unicodedata
# Test per-character approach
def strip_accents(text):
    out = []
    for ch in text:
        dec = unicodedata.normalize('NFD', ch)
        if len(dec) > 1:
            # decomposed: keep non-Mn parts
            out.append(''.join(c for c in dec if unicodedata.category(c) != 'Mn'))
        else:
            out.append(ch)
    return ''.join(out)

cases = {
    'café': 'cafe',
    'café': 'cafe',
    '日本語': '日本語',
    'naïve': 'naive',
    'Ångström': 'Angstrom',
    'e\u0301': 'e',
    'Å\u030A': 'A',
    'ß': 'ß',
    'Plain ASCII 123!': 'Plain ASCII 123!',
    '': '',
    '한국어': '한국어',
    '한국어': '한국어',
    '한국어': '한국어',
    'señor': 'senor',
    'Ω': 'Ω',
    'Ω': 'Ω',
}
for inp, exp in cases.items():
    out = strip_accents(inp)
    ok = 'OK ' if out == exp else 'FAIL'
    print(ok, repr(inp), '->', repr(out), '(expected', repr(exp), ')')
print()
# Lone combining mark
print('lone mark:', repr(strip_accents('\u0301')))
